desc: Read N and S from stdin, collect 0-indexed positions of every '1'.
Compute adjusted array b_j = p_j - j (j from 0) and find its median.
Sum |b_j - median| and print the integer to stdout.
Verify on the three samples (passed: 3, 0, 7); solution correct.
Confirm O(N) time and unbounded integer arithmetic for N up to 5*10^5.
